title: Plan D amending context gathered — 3 QA residuals confirmed; ADR/ASR infra absent
body: Gathered artifact context for amending TASK-universal-media-decomposer-D. Confirmed all 3 residual QA findings from qa-reviewer log L8 + qa-test-analyzer L20 are genuine, distinct, and archaeology-consistent: (1) StructuredQuery continuity_id/temporal_from/to/spatial declared+forwarded by /v1/query/structured but never applied — _temporal_conditions()=[]/_spatial_meta()=note in projections/query.py; exec-worker P2 L11 explicitly records these were 'hook-parameters (not deep filters) pending Phase-3 typed input', so the gap is a documented handoff that Phase 3 never closed; CONTRACTS.md:41 + DD §REST 190 require them; DD §Temporal/spatial 273-274 require distinct time/spatial representation. (2) /v1/entities/{ref}/merge|split (entities.py:119-159) call SemanticCommandService.entity_resolve which only appends EntityResolved, never invoking the P1 Resolver/PostgresSplitEnumerator — so mention rebinding, ReferenceRebound, and ambiguity quarantine are unreachable via REST though tested at service layer (test_resolution_merge_split); build_context does not wire Resolver; DD §Reversible entity resolution 271 + CONTRACTS.md:37 mandate reachable reversible split. (3) /v1/segments/{id}/evidence (sources.py:171-198) passes segment_id to source-scoped get_by_source (WHERE source_id==segment_id) with no segment->source resolution and getattr default None — wrong/empty; CONTRACTS.md:44 + DD §184/§257 require locator/evidence retrieval. exec-manager L30 routes fix-cycle-2 as Exec-Planner AMEND for #1+#2 with #3's concrete correction included in the same amendment. CORPUS GAP: artifacts/decisions/ and artifacts/requirements/ DO NOT EXIST — zero ADRs/ASRs in the entire UMD corpus; all binding constraints live in CONTRACTS.md + DD + Task.md. No ADR/ASR infra to search; skipped per opt-in policy. No prior dead-ends or failed approaches specific to these three remediations recorded.
